description.narrative: The project aims to address the specific objective within the EUACI's thematic directions, focusing on civil society and media engagement in preventing and fighting corruption. Specifically, it seeks to reduce corruption levels in Ukraine by enhancing society's awareness of corruption through high-quality investigative media content exposing major corruption cases. Additionally, the project aims to strengthen the capacity of regional journalistic investigators and anti-corruption activists to combat corruption locally .
